description: This file defines the class tlCodeTracker, which manages code tracker entities, interactions with the database, and integration with external systems within the TestLink project. It includes methods for CRUD operations, linking to test projects, environment checks, and configuration validation.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: Manages code tracker entities within TestLink, handling CRUD operations, linking test projects, environment validation, and configuration parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tlCodeTracker instance with a database handler and populates system types.

methods.name: getSystems
methods.description: Returns system configurations filtered by status (enabled/disabled/all).

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the types of enabled systems.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns the implementation interface name for a given tracker type.

methods.name: getEntitySpec
methods.description: Returns the specification of entity fields (name, cfg, type).

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new code tracker entry after validation and XML configuration checks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing code tracker entry after validation and duplicate checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a code tracker entry if it is not linked to any test project.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves a code tracker by its ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a code tracker by its name.

methods.name: getByAttr
methods.description: Retrieves a code tracker by specified attribute.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates input object properties before database operations.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Associates a code tracker with a test project.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes association between a code tracker and a test project.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Retrieves all test projects linked to a specific code tracker.

methods.name: getLinkSet
methods.description: Retrieves all link associations between code trackers and test projects.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all code trackers with optional extended info like link counts and environment check status.

methods.name: getLinkedTo
methods.description: Gets the test project linked to a specific code tracker ID.

methods.name: getInterfaceObject
methods.description: Returns an interface object for the linked test project, with session caching.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks if the connection to a code tracker is operational.

methods.name: checkXMLCfg
methods.description: Validates the format of an XML configuration string.
